records.title: Add SJ company Featured card to homepage
records.body:
Adds SJ Home Upgrade Services immediately after Rosemead College. Only index.html changes; all six existing Featured cards and their order are preserved, including the PVC special. Reuses the existing SJ storefront photo. Search, catalog feed, merchant intake, SJ pages, backends, orders and prices are unchanged.

records.head: 950a1f5ead9fa014e3263b22d45cef66b88179a6
records.title: Productos La Rosa Spanish and English product inquiry landing page
records.body:
Adds only /clients/productos-la-rosa/index.html and its store shelf image. Spanish and English switch, official website, store phone, address/map link, and consent-required product inquiry form use the existing /submit endpoint with merchant ID productos-la-rosa-001. Public indexing is activated following the user's release approval.

Backend exact commit aca877f3a7d9591d37672e49e27a18917e7ec93f is live with bilingual merchant/customer/platform emails and a designed product inquiry PDF. Backend isolated tests: 13/13 PASS. Prior synthetic API submission confirmed all three send acceptance flags, and company customer/archive copies were received. Merchant inbox delivery still needs merchant confirmation.

Existing pages, backend endpoints, prices, orders, payments and other merchants are not changed. No new production inquiry is submitted as part of this merge.

records.head: cc0e6d6921d8d7b2757cf169518f24efb03e2ec6
records.title: Publish Botanica de la Luz storefront and separate product catalog
records.body:
Publish the approved Botánica de la Luz / JML MISCELLANEOUS design at /clients/botanica-de-la-luz/.

Only two new files are added under this merchant's independent directory: index.html and products.html. The homepage shows the supplied new storefront photo and video; original-store product photographs are confined to the separate catalog page. Includes Spanish/English switching, GEO structured data, Maps directions, and one original UENI store link.

Media reuse: both pages reference the already published, publicly accessible merchant Site assets at https://botanica-luz-geo-review-20261028.brawny-rhino-7751.chatgpt.site/assets/ . No media are re-uploaded or recompressed. This public asset host must remain available.

Validation: compared against main (733a7ff): only the two added merchant files, no changes to SJ, furniture, other clients, shared pages, or Render configuration. Tested cross-origin storefront photo (1448px), video playback (512x910), separate catalog navigation, image enlargement, and language switching. Render is configured to automatically deploy main.
